    METHOD & SCOPE

    One task. Two fixed sets of parameters.

    A fair comparison. Both controllers start at the same position and see the same scheduled target movement and visibility changes. Their own movement changes their retinal input. Each uses the same model equations.

    A new test, not new training. The learned gains come from the separate target-learning experiment. They are not guaranteed to win on your task. No weights change during a challenge, and no helper reveals the target.

    An inspectable result. The server repeats completed trials from the supplied task and parameters. Shared links preserve those inputs. This confirms reproducibility, not biological validity or the origin of user-supplied weights.
